shellCommands.command:
set -e
BASE=http://localhost:3939

echo "== 1. Home page (empty) =="
curl -s $BASE/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress yet" | head -1

echo "== 2. Add a book (currently reading) =="
RESP=$(curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"The Pragmatic Programmer","author":"Hunt & Thomas","notes":"Re-reading chapters 1-3"}')
echo "$RESP"
ID=$(echo "$RESP" | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).id))")
echo "Book id: $ID"

echo "== 3. Home page shows it in Currently reading =="
curl -s $BASE/ | grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer" | head -1

echo "== 4. Book detail page =="
curl -s $BASE/books/$ID | grep -o "Re-reading chapters 1-3" | head -1

echo "== 5. Update notes =="
curl -s -X PATCH $BASE/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"notes":"Chapter 4 was great"}' | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(d).notes))"

echo "== 6. Mark as finished =="
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/books/$ID/finish | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const b=JSON.parse(d);console.log('finished='+b.finished)})"

echo "== 7. Home page shows it under Finished =="
curl -s $BASE/ | grep -o "Finished" | head -1

echo "== 8. Validation: missing title =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST $BASE/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"author":"Nobody"}'

echo "== 9. JSON file persisted =="
cat data/books.json

BASE=http://localhost:3939
echo "== After restart: home page still shows the book under Finished =="
curl -s $BASE/ | grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer" | head -1
echo "== Detail page still has updated notes =="
curl -s $BASE/books/bfad8424-ce4d-4dd7-9681-3419336b2733 | grep -o "Chapter 4 was great" | head -1
echo "== Add a second book to confirm writes still work after restart =="
curl -s -X POST $BASE/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Atomic Habits","author":"James Clear"}' | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const b=JSON.parse(d);console.log(b.title+' by '+b.author+' finished='+b.finished)})"
